plugins.name: Notible Graph
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: ALPHA — a map of your workspace: every note, task and project is a dot, and lines show what links to what. Good for spotting notes that nothing points to and links between projects.

plugins.name: Notible Habits
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: Track habits in the sidebar: tick off what is due today, keep a streak, and see a year at a glance. Daily, on chosen weekdays, every few days or a weekly target.

plugins.name: Notible Library
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: Organize books, films, series and games into named libraries, with ratings, covers and Find online for books.

plugins.name: Notible Notifications
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: A bell in the sidebar that keeps what Notible told you — reminders and automation messages — so a missed notification isn't gone. Also simple reminders: a message, a date and a time.

plugins.name: ReportIt
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: Turn chosen notes, tasks and issues into one tidy PDF report with a cover, contents and page numbers. Your notes stay as they are.

plugins.name: Schemas
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: Build reusable title and property recipes, attach them to projects, and keep an independent counter for each project.

plugins.name: Notible Sync
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: Keep this workspace the same on your own computers through your Google Drive. Everything is encrypted on your computer first, so neither Notible nor Google can read it.

plugins.name: Notible Sync Simple
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: Keep this workspace the same on your own computers through Google Drive, without pairing them. The key is kept on your Drive, so anyone who can sign in to that Google account can read the workspace.

plugins.name: Notible Tables
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: Simple spreadsheets inside Notible: a grid you can sort, filter, format and fill quickly, kept as an ordinary item you can link from any note.

plugins.name: Notible Teams
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: Test version: share a project with a few people through the Notible Teams server. It is encrypted on your computer before it leaves.

plugins.name: Nib
plugins.author: Notible
plugins.description: A little folded-note fella in the corner of your notes. Click him (or press Ctrl+Shift+H when you are not typing in a note) and ask how Notible works. Answers come only from the Help and the plugins in your version, offline; questions are not saved or sent anywhere. If a feature belongs to a built-in plugin that is off, Nib says so and offers to open it in Settings.
